vectors.name: infer/basic/repeated-label-becomes-unbounded-array
vectors.comment: A label seen more than once in any sample becomes [0,] -- min=0, not the observed minimum count (2 in the first sample). infer is permissive on array length by design.

vectors.name: infer/allow-any/conflicting-scalar-kinds-fail-by-default
vectors.comment: integer vs. string is not the one sanctioned integer/number subtype relation, so this is a hard failure without allow_any.

vectors.name: infer/allow-any/conflicting-scalar-kinds-open-to-any-when-allowed

fallbacks.reason: values of more than one scalar kind (integer, string)

vectors.comment: infer_with_report's allow_any=true path: opens the field to any AND reports the opening with a location and reason -- never silent.

vectors.name: infer/errors/zero-samples-is-an-error
vectors.comment: Exercises the algebra's own contract directly rather than the omnist CLI, whose `input` argument requires at least one positional file (nargs='+') and so can never actually be invoked with zero samples -- the CLI's argument parser enforces this one step before the algebra would. Path is $ since no schema exists yet at this failure point -- this is a pre-schema, sample-shape error, not a schema-side one, so Sec8.4's RecordName-based Schema path form doesn't apply.

vectors.name: infer/errors/scalar-rooted-sample-is-an-error
vectors.comment: Samples MUST be node-rooted; a bare scalar sample has no labels to infer fields from. Path is $ for the same reason as infer/errors/zero-samples-is-an-error -- no schema exists yet at this failure point.
